headline: Support the Brotherhood.
body: Donations fund workshops, service supplies, speaker travel, convention travel, and need-based dues support for University of Tampa brothers.

tiers.name: The Supporter
tiers.description: Underwrites materials for one skills workshop.

tiers.name: The Mentor
tiers.description: Sponsors a semester of MCAT cohort resources.

tiers.name: The Partner
tiers.description: Funds a named service drive or speaker event.

tiers.name: Legacy Giving
tiers.description: Endow lasting scholarship or dues assistance.

quote: Supporting MED at UT means more brothers get to clinics, conferences, and the next step in healthcare.
